<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. Solve one problem per pull request.
Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as "fix(web): new threads no longer spike CPU".
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior and
reproduction steps or environment where relevant. Link the issue if there is one. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If it spans the server and the clients,
explain why those changes are needed for the same fix. Split independent fixes. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the focused tests or manual checks you ran and what you saw for the
changed behavior. State anything you could not check. "Tests pass" alone is not enough.

For UI changes, include before/after screenshots, and a short recording when motion,
timing or interaction matters. Upload them to GitHub. Never commit PR-only assets. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
